admin.kpi.note: Product north metrics: D30 retention and K-factor. Affiliate conversion is measured passively, never optimized (golden rule 6). Templates and editorial excluded from K-factor.
admin.mod.title: Moderation queue
admin.mod.how: Every pool, option, comment and name passes the blacklist matcher before publishing. Remove → content becomes “not available”.
admin.health.title: System health

admin.temas.how: AI proposes pools from news, calendar and sports. No operator prices or numeric operator comparisons. The cron NEVER publishes on its own: you decide here. Publish → pool source=editorial (excluded from K-factor).
